attr.title: MewnBase
attr.desc: Explore an alien planet as a space cat, gather resources and build a base to survive.
attr.inst: Install MewnBase.zip, then copy your owned game/desktop-1.0.jar and complete data folder into the installed mewnbase folder. See mewnbase.md for supported files and installation steps. Requires compatible 64-bit ARM firmware and PortMaster Java 17 and Westonpack runtimes.
